en: The Dhāraṇī of the Pavilion of the Great Vajra Sumeru,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, Imperial Censor of the Third Rank, Acting Assistant Director of the Court of State Ceremonial,
and Dharma Master Subject Shi Hu, by imperial decree.
Namo ratnatrayāya | namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ | atha vajrakrodha-vijaya-kṣye ||
Namo buddhāya, namo dharmāya, namaḥ saṃghāya, namaḥ sarvavidyāsamyaksaṃbuddhavidyāśrīvajragarbhadhisattvasaṃghebhyaḥ.
Vīrya namaḥ śrīvajrapāṇaye mahāyakṣasenāpataye namo vajrakrodharājāya namo.
Namaḥ vajraśaṅkarāya | Namaḥ vajrasanāya | Namaḥ vajravegāya | Namaḥ vajranandāya | Namaḥ vajrarakṣāya...
Namaḥ samayāya | Namaḥ mahāmelayāya | Namaḥ vajravīradhāriṇe | Namaḥ naravīrāya | Namaḥ vajrakīlikīlaya | Namaḥ vajrāya ||
Namaḥ kumāraya, namo vajrakālaya, namo vajrahūtāśanāya, namo vajraśṛṅkhalāya, namo susiddhikarāya vīrye.
Yarañjaya namo 'parājita namaścāṇa sasteḥ vibhūvavajradharādhipate namo vajrakrodha...
